newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Costello agrees to Westpac-BML merger.
newsitem.headline: Costello agrees to Westpac-BML merger.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday he had given in-principle agreement to the merger of Westpac Banking Corp and the Bank of Melbourne Ltd.

Costello said the decision was based on advice from the Reserve Bank of Australia about relevant prudential considerations, submissions from both banks, and the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission's view that the merger would not contravene the Trade Practices Act.
The commission is holding a news conference at midday (0200 GMT) to discuss its decision on the merger.
Costello said in a statement that the final decision regarding the merger remained with the shareholders. Westpac announced the A$1.44 billion merger on April 3.
